title: Daily digest: Chess Olympiad countdown in Hyderabad, Karimnagar rains, India clause in Russia sanctions bill
headline: 📰 LATEST NEWS — TOP 3 TODAY
source: Telangana Today / The Hindu / Munsif Daily
bullets_en: Hyderabad marked the Chess Olympiad 2026 countdown with a ceremonial torch handover.
Rain has brought relief to farmers in Telangana's Karimnagar district.
US lawmakers are seeking an India clause in the Russia sanctions bill.
bullets_ur: Hyderabad mein Chess Olympiad 2026 countdown ka aaghaaz ceremonial torch handover ke saath hua.
Telangana ke Karimnagar district mein barish ne kisano ko rahat di hai.
US lawmakers Russia sanctions bill mein India clause ki maang kar rahe hain.
